mendations of the Bureau of the Budget

and Accounting Procedures Act of 1 9 5 0 , 
approved September 12, 1950 (64 Stat.  
834 ; 31 U.S.C. 18b), relating to the devel­
opment of programs for preparing  
statistical information by Executive  
agencies. Such inspection shall be in  
accordance and upon compliance with  
the rules and regulations prescribed by  
the Secretary of the Treasury in the two 
Treasury decisions,1  relating to the in­
